sentences: Last month, our class open a lost-property desk beside the school office.
On the first morning, two pupil brought a scarf and a pair of gloves.
Our teacher asked us write a short description of each item.
We kept the descriptions in a folder, but we did not wrote anyone's name on the noticeboard.
Matching the gloves was more easier than finding the scarf's owner, who was very happily when we finally called her.
A younger child thanked the classmates helped him look for his gloves.
The scarf belonged to a girl which had return to the music room to look for it.
At the end of the week, everyone agreed that our small desk had been a useful experiences.

修改记录2（任选错误，顺序不限）
修改记录3（任选错误，顺序不限）
review_response_tasks.rationale: asked us to write，不定式to加在write前；未预标位置。

review_response_tasks.stem: 修改记录4（任选错误，顺序不限）
review_response_tasks.rationale: did not后主动态动词原形write。

review_response_tasks.stem: 修改记录5（任选错误，顺序不限）
review_response_tasks.rationale: 双重比较more easier可删more；也可将easier改easy，构成more easy，列为同一错误的替代修法。

review_response_tasks.stem: 修改记录6（任选错误，顺序不限）
review_response_tasks.rationale: was后用happy描述失主的状态，不能用副词happily作此表语。

review_response_tasks.stem: 修改记录7（任选错误，顺序不限）
review_response_tasks.rationale: classmates后可加who/that引出过去帮助过他的同学；也可把helped改helping作主动分词后置修饰。三修法同属一个错误，不重复计入。

review_response_tasks.stem: 修改记录8（任选错误，顺序不限）
review_response_tasks.rationale: girl指人，限定性定语从句主语可用who/that。

review_response_tasks.stem: 修改记录9（任选错误，顺序不限）
修改记录10（任选错误，顺序不限）
review_response_tasks.rationale: a useful后此处表示一次经历，用单数experience。

corrected_passage_variants: Last month, our class opened a lost-property desk beside the school office. On the first morning, two pupils brought a scarf and a pair of gloves. Our teacher asked us to write a short description of each item. We kept the descriptions in a folder, but we did not write anyone's name on the noticeboard. Matching the gloves was easier than finding the scarf's owner, who was very happy when we finally called her. A younger child thanked the classmates who helped him look for his gloves. The scarf belonged to a girl who had returned to the music room to look for it. At the end of the week, everyone agreed that our small desk had been a useful experience.
